# j100-client single-file bundle

Generated by `scripts/build_single_file.py`. The bundle embeds the full
j100_client package (CLI + API) in one file; run it with venv Python


## Check status of J1xx phones

```console
python3 j100-client.py status \
  --insecure \
  --password mypass \
  10.10.10.1 10.10.10.2 \
```

## Restart a J1xx phone

```console
python3 j100-client.py restart \
  --insecure \
  --password mypass \
  10.10.10.1\
```
